newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Graphics sees 20 pct rev rise in '98.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Graphics sees 20 pct rev rise in '98.

text.p: SAN FRANCISCO, April 28 (Reuyter) - Silicon Graphics Inc's 1998 revenue could rise 20 percent, led by strong server sales, in 1998, the computer maker's chief executive said.
Silicon Graphics' operating income will grow by better than 10 percent in the same period, Ed McCracken, chief executive officer, told investors at the Hambrecht and Quist technology conference here.
Silicon Graphics makes desktop engineering computers, servers to control the flow of information through networks, and supercomputers.
